text:
anya: quick copy pass for the KV cache warmup tooltip + the empty state on Console > Models > Caching. looking for short alternatives and an accessibility check. tl;dr: users confuse "warmup" with 'preload' and the current tooltip feels scary.

anya: current tooltip proposed: `KV cache stores recent keys to reduce latency and token cost. Warmup may increase initial inference cost while filling the cache.` thoughts?

kevin: feels wordy. can we lead with benefit first? e.g. `Reuse recent context to lower latency and token use. Preloading the KV cache may increase initial cost.` shorter, keeps noun -> verb? :thumbsup:

anya: i like that ordering. does anyone prefer the word 'preload' vs 'warmup'? product asked for 'warmup' originally.

sophia: accessibility nit: avoid jargon for end-users. 'Preload' is clearer than 'warmup' imo. also suggest adding aria-friendly label and keep under ~90 chars for screen readers.

kevin: alternative short versions to choose from (feel free to pick A/B/C):
A: `Reuse recent context to speed responses and cut token use. Preloading the KV cache may raise initial cost.`
B: `Reuse recent context for faster responses and lower token costs. Warming the KV cache may increase initial usage.`
C: `Preload recent context to reduce latency and token consumption. Initial preloads may incur extra cost.`

anya: love A for tone, C reads a bit too product-y. B uses 'warming' which sophia flagged. leaning A.

sophia: minor: 'token use' vs 'token consumption' — both fine; 'use' is friendlier. also, add a micro-CTA for the empty state like 'Try preloading to improve perf' but make it a verb-first button label.

anya: empty state copy draft (when no cache warming has been run):
`No KV cache data yet — responses may be slower and cost more.
Preload recent traffic to improve latency.`
CTA label options: `Preload cache` / `Warm cache` / `Start preload`

kevin: prefer `Preload cache` btn. shorter, consistent with tooltip. use sentence case on the empty state: 'No KV cache data yet — responses may be slower and cost more.' good.

anya: accessibility checklist for this tooltip/empty state:
- Ensure tooltip text is reachable by keyboard focus (focusable info icon)
- Provide aria-describedby linking the info icon to the tooltip content
- Keep tooltip under 140 characters for screen reader brevity
- Button labels should be explicit: `Preload cache` (not just 'Start')

sophia: also check color contrast on the info icon hover state — current design uses 60% gray, needs to meet AA when inside the table row.

anya: quick mock in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/kvcache-copy (updated frames: tooltip + empty state + focused state). please review.

kevin: tiny copy nit for confirmation dialog when user clicks preload: current copy: `Preloading will incur extra cost while cache fills. Continue?`

kevin: suggestion: `Preloading the KV cache may incur additional cost while it fills. Proceed with preload?` (slightly softer)

sophia: shorter: `Preloading may incur extra cost while the cache fills. Proceed?` keeps the action in the button (Proceed / Cancel).

anya: consensus? I'm going to implement A for tooltip, empty state line + `Preload cache` CTA, and use sophia's shorter confirmation copy. will push to the copy layer in the figma and update the accessibility notes.

design-bot: updated figma frame "KV cache — copy pass" at 1773387700.

kevin: :thumbsup: thanks. will sync with backend on telemetry name `kv_cache.preload` so we can attribute.

anya: thanks all — i'll do a final pass and send to product/legal if needed.

kevin: small follow-up: can we instrument a tooltip `learn more` link to docs? if so add: `/docs/caching#kv-cache-preload`

anya: yes adding a `Learn more` link to the tooltip that opens docs in a new tab. i'll add link text `Learn more about cache preloads`.

sophia: sounds good. approved from a11y perspective pending contrast check.

anya: closing the thread — will post the final copy when pushed. :sparkles:
